2026.narrative: McLaren & Lando Norris capture their first modern World Championship in the debut season of Active Aero & Manual Override regulations.

2027.narrative: Max Verstappen delivers a masterclass season to regain the crown with 9 victories, holding off a fierce challenge from McLaren and Ferrari.

2028.engine_type: 2.4L V8 Naturally Aspirated (20,000 RPM) + Classic DRS
2028.narrative: The glorious return of screaming 20,000 RPM V8 engines sees Scuderia Ferrari dominate the technical reset, crowning Charles Leclerc World Champion.

2029.engine_type: 2.4L V8 Naturally Aspirated (20,000 RPM) + Classic DRS
2029.narrative: Max Verstappen conquers a titanic three-way title duel against McLaren's Piastri and Ferrari's Leclerc, winning the decider in Abu Dhabi.

2030.engine_type: 2.4L V8 Naturally Aspirated (20,000 RPM) + Classic DRS
2030.narrative: A sensational new era dawns as prodigy Kimi Antonelli captures his maiden Formula 1 World Drivers' Championship alongside teammate George Russell.
